about: What each reaction means and when it fits (7 Nov 2026). Built by a context-map agent looking at every sticker at ~360 / 200 / 120 px, then checked by a second agent; 'second_opinion' holds its corrections, which override where they differ. Use with PLAYBOOK.md 'Fit the context'.

grin.name: The Grin
grin.full_arc: grin_full (218 f, 0-7.27 s): the grin is already on at 0.0 s, so the full arc adds length, not an onset
grin.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as named: a big, warm, happy grin. Clear at 120-180 px. It is the only clean 'good' face in either set.
grin.meaning: good news for us; told you so; proud
fits: a cheap fee or a bonus that is the point of the line
the good branch of a worked example, as a flash only (<=1.2 s)

crypto: I called it at $0.40. It's $1.10 today.
The airdrop landed: 1,200 tokens for a few test trades.
football: Told you Saka would score. 1-0 Arsenal.
Both picks came in, the double pays 3.40.

never: any loss, cost or risk to the viewer (reads as gloating)
a held reaction on an even-money example (flash only)
a suspicious claim (it would look like you believe it)

buildup.detail: held from the first frame of the raw clip; enter it with the squash swap from the listening face

grin.notes: Use it as the end callback when it was also the payoff face earlier (same meaning both times).

jawdrop.name: Jaw Drop
jawdrop.full_arc: jawdrop_full (233 f): mouth open and hand on chin from 0.0 s; no onset
jawdrop.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as shocked / amazed (open mouth, hand on chin). The valence is ambiguous: 'wow' or 'oh no' is decided entirely by what is on screen.
jawdrop.misread_as: the wrong valence (wow vs oh no) if the stimulus is not obviously green or red; looks fake with no visible trigger
fits: a real reveal the viewer could not predict
a huge number that is the point of the section

crypto: TVL went from $2M to $300M in one week.
One wallet was holding 40% of the whole supply.
football: From 3-0 down, they won it 4-3 in stoppage time.
A 35-yard volley, straight into the top corner.

never: the setup line before the number is on screen

buildup.detail: no onset in the raw clip; must cut in on the reveal itself

jawdrop.notes: Needs an unmistakable trigger landing on screen at the same instant; the 4 Nov use gasped at an empty box.
jawdrop.second_opinion: Intensity 2: no eye widening; hand on chin = speechless. Fits speechless disbelief at an outrageous claim. Never on examples.

waitwhat.name: Wait, What?
waitwhat.full_arc: waitwhat_full (163 f): the frown is on from 0.0 s; no onset
waitwhat.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads smaller than its name: a serious, sceptical frown with wide eyes. At 120 px it is close to a stern neutral face; 'confused disbelief' only shows at 240 px and up.
waitwhat.misread_as: plain serious / stern neutral (under-reads, never wrong-valence)
waitwhat.meaning: hold on, that doesn't sound right
fits: a rule nobody explained / the catch
a claim to doubt in the grey set (alt to Side-Eye)

crypto: The fee isn't 1%. It's 1% per day.
Losses pull your score down faster than wins push it up.
football: They sold their top scorer the day before the deadline.
The ref gave a penalty for that?

never: a definition the viewer must learn (it makes the teaching look confusing)

buildup.detail: held; the change from the Side-Eye neutral is small, so give it a squash swap and a lean back

waitwhat.second_opinion: Reads at 200 px as wide eyes, brows raised and knitted: alarmed 'wait, what?'; worried at 120 px (fine on risky lines). Not neutral.

yikes.name: Yikes
yikes.full_arc: yikes_full (182 f): teeth bared from 0.0 s; no onset
yikes.reads_at_sticker_size: Yikes reads as a big toothy GRIN. The furrowed brow and squint that make it a cringe are lost below ~300 px; at 120-180 px it is nearly the same face as The Grin.
yikes.meaning: cringe, awkward, that's going to hurt
fits: a self-own told as a joke
awful form, said with a wry tone

crypto: I bought the top. Exactly the top.
He went 50x long on a meme coin, with his rent money.
football: They haven't won away from home since August.
The keeper tried to dribble past the striker.

never: a straight loss to the viewer ($0, 'they lost the match')
a rug or hack with real victims
yikes.notes: Only safe where a grimace-grin is the intended joke. For a plain loss in the grey set use Sob (minor) or Wail (major).
yikes.second_opinion: Min 360 px: at 360 an 'eek' grimace, at 200 px or less a grin.

itsover.name: It's Over
itsover.full_arc: itsover_full (255 f): hands fly up and land on the head over frames 1-24 (0-0.8 s), held to ~7.4 s (frame ~225), drop 226-238 (motion blur), short neutral tail 240-255
itsover.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads clearly as 'disaster / oh no' because of the hands on the head; the face alone is only a mild wide-eyed 'oh'. The gesture carries it at any size.
itsover.misread_as: none, if the crop keeps the hands (needs headroom above the face)
fits: the single biggest loss of the video

crypto: At 20% down, it closes everything.
The bridge was drained: $120M gone overnight.
football: 95th minute... they equalise.
Relegated on the last day, on goal difference.

never: a second time in the same video

buildup.detail: use itsover_full from frame ~1-12 so the hands RISE on the line and LAND on the key word (frame ~24 = landed)

itsover.avoid_frames: itsover_full 226-255 (hands drop with heavy blur, then an oddly framed neutral)
itsover.notes: Once per video. Tall shape: plan the anchor so the hands are not cropped by a card.
itsover.second_opinion: No neutral onset: hands already in the air at frame 1 (floating islands 1-5), clasp the head ~20; mouth open 1-8. Chin cut at the mouth, keep the bottom edge behind a card. Football: reads as 'so close'; for a defeat use Wail.

lol.name: LOL
lol.full_arc: lol_full (174 f): laughing from 0.0 s; no onset
lol.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as named: a big open-mouth laugh. Unmistakable at 120 px.
lol.misread_as: none (but it reads as mocking if the line is someone's real loss)
fits: an own goal / a comic fail

crypto: The token is literally called $DOGWIFHAT2.
Their roadmap's next step is 'vibes'.
football: An own goal from the halfway line.
He celebrated before the ball crossed the line... and it didn't.

never: a real loss to the viewer
the payoff of a serious explainer
lol.notes: Laughter lands at the phrase boundary (after the punchline), not mid-sentence.

sideeye.name: Side-Eye
sideeye.full_arc: sideeye_full (242 f): neutral 1-57 (0-1.9 s, the grey listening idle); look to SCREEN-LEFT 60-100 (2.0-3.3 s, head turns left, eyes cut left); centre 101-145; look to SCREEN-RIGHT 148-182 (4.9-6.0 s); neutral again 185-242 (6.1-8.0 s)
sideeye.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as suspicion only IN MOTION and aimed at something; a still frame of the look reads as just a turned head. The neutral parts read as calm listening.
sideeye.misread_as: looking away / distracted, if not aimed at the claim on screen
sideeye.meaning: sure, buddy; I don't buy it
fits: a promise that sounds too good

crypto: They say it's a guaranteed 30% APY.
Trust me, this one won't rug.
football: He says they'll win the league this year.
The tipster calls it a 'certain' over 3.5.

never: the product's own feature you are recommending (looks like you doubt your own point)
sideeye.motion: the head turn IS the motion; place the sticker so the look points at the claim (left look for a sticker right of the thing, right look for one left of it)

buildup.detail: neutral -> look; land frame ~65 (eyes cut) on the claim word

sideeye.use_frames: sideeye_full 1-57 + 185-242 as listening idle; 58-104 (left look) or 145-185 (right look) as the beat
sideeye.avoid_frames: the trimmed sticker ends mid-right-look (frame 111+); use the full arc
sideeye.notes: The only grey listening material (about 3.8 s total, loop ping-pong).
sideeye.second_opinion: Look 1 (60-100) = head turned away with a sideways glance: dismissive. Look 2 (148-182) = head and eyes toward screen-right and down: 'eyeing it'. The neutral reads serious, slightly sceptical.

sob.name: The Sob
sob.full_arc: sob_full (193 f): the crying face from 0.0 s; no onset
sob.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as a pained, sour squint with a down-turned mouth: 'gutted' or 'ouch'. It does not read as crying (no tears, no open mouth) and can pass for disgust.
fits: the losing branch of an example, as a flash

crypto: My airdrop: zero tokens.
I sold at $0.30. It's $0.90 now.
football: Our first pick lost 1-0.
My favourite isn't even in the starting XI.

never: catastrophes (too small: use Wail / It's Over)
sob.notes: As a flash (<=1 s) it counts as intensity 1: right for '$0' in a worked example.

wail.name: The Wail
wail.full_arc: wail_full (173 f): grimace with bared teeth 5-35 (0.15-1.15 s), the open-mouth wail 38-62 (1.25-2.05 s), then an angry / crying frown 63-173 (a brief teeth grimace ~108-122)
wail.reads_at_sticker_size: The wail (1.25-2.05 s) reads unmistakably as anguish and the frown after it as gutted / angry. BUT its first second (bared-teeth grimace) reads as a grin at sticker size.
wail.misread_as: a grin during the grimace onset (sticker frames 1-9, full 5-35)

crypto: And then it went to zero. Rugged.
Second stop loss in one day.
football: We lost 5-0. At home.
Missed the penalty that would have won the final.

never: alongside It's Over in the same video

buildup.detail: start at wail_full ~36 so the scream opens on the word; the frown (63+) is a usable 'gutted' hold

wail.avoid_frames: wail_full 1-35 and 108-122; sticker 1-9 (grimace reads as a grin)
wail.notes: Alternative hero to It's Over for losses that already happened.
wail.second_opinion: Onset 1-35 reads as a pained grimace at 200 px+ (grin only ~120 px). Frames 63-107 = an angry glare: the grey set's 'annoyed' face at intensity 2. 'Never with It's Over' covers only the scream (38-62).

stare.name: The Stare
stare.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as neutral, attentive and a little worried (raised brows, slight pout), NOT as 'unimpressed'. It is a listening face; the deadpan 'really?' only comes from context.
stare.misread_as: concerned / sad if held on a happy line
fits: the default listening face between beats (shirtless set)

crypto: Most apps treat your data like free storage.
They want a 2% fee... for 'convenience'.
football: The manager says the team is 'in a good place'.
They've drawn six of their last seven.

stare.motion: breathing only; lean toward the thing
stare.avoid_frames: 115-123 (head pulls back, scale and lighting jump; frame 123 visibly smaller)
stare.second_opinion: Mildly negative (glum, concerned), not neutral. Listening loop 40-110; frames 1-30 raise the brows ('really?') for a deliberate deadpan beat; 115-123 jump.

wince.name: The Wince
wince.reads_at_sticker_size: Wince reads as a GRIN. Frames 1-30 (0.2-1.2 s) are a genuine warm smile; from ~1.3 s the eyes squeeze, but at 120-180 px that reads as laughing with eyes shut, not pain. The forehead lines that say 'ouch' need 450 px and up.
wince.meaning: ouch, that stings (comic); or, frames 1-30 only, a warm smile
fits: frames 1-30: a sign-off smile in the shirtless set

crypto: I paid $80 in gas for a $20 mint.
(frames 1-30) Link's in the post, anyways.
football: He hit the post, then the bar, then his own keeper.
(frames 1-30) Two from two. See you tomorrow.

never: a straight loss or defeat (reads as a grin)
a long hold meant as a smile (the squeeze phase plays)

buildup.detail: smile (1-30) -> eye squeeze (35-55) -> held grimace-grin; one eye closes more near the end

wince.notes: The playbook's 'a loss' use does not survive the size test.
wince.second_opinion: Smile = frames 1-25 (brow knits ~30). At 360 px with a clearly comic-bad stimulus 45-144 can read as cringe; at 200 px 50/50. Never on a straight loss.

noway.name: No Way!
noway.reads_at_sticker_size: The peak (frames 28-44, 3.0-3.55 s) reads unmistakably as an outraged shout. The start (1-12) is a sceptical frown with moving lips; the tail (66-75) is a grimace that reads as a smirk.
fits: the worst version of the problem
a rule that makes no sense

crypto: Connect the account, and they can keep reading it.
They want 20% of your tokens just to list you.
football: A red card for THAT?
£150M for a 19-year-old with ten league games.

never: anything the script says in a normal voice that is not the problem's peak
noway.motion: lean IN toward the thing (outrage), then settle

buildup.detail: frown (1-12) -> eyes widen (15-25) -> shout peak 37 (3.3 s); start ~15 so the eyes widen on the word and the shout lands 0.2 s after

noway.notes: The shirtless set's strongest 'bad' face after Shook; give it the problem's climax.
noway.second_opinion: The peak is a wide-eyed shout: shock ('WHAT?!'), valence decided by the stimulus. Its peak ~ Shook frame 10: count them as one face per video.

ugh.name: Ugh
ugh.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as named at 180 px and up: eyes squeezed shut, nose scrunched, can't look. At 120 px it can look like straining or sleepy. Static the whole clip.
ugh.misread_as: straining / eyes shut (very small sizes only)
fits: someone taking more than they should

crypto: Upload a statement, and they get every trade, the timing and your balance.
The team dumped 30% of the supply on launch day.
football: That was the worst penalty I've seen all season.
Diving in the box. Again.

never: risks that haven't happened yet (use Nervous)

buildup.detail: held, static; keep the hold <=2 s or it reads as a frozen photo

ugh.notes: Its library 'use' list already names oversharing data.

shook.name: Shook
shook.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as named: wide eyes, open mouth, brows up: shocked, scared. Clear at 120 px. Leans toward fear, so it cannot carry a happy surprise.
fits: a hero beat in the shirtless set

crypto: The audit missed it: a $50M exploit.
One wallet holds 60% of the supply.
football: Their keeper was sent off in the 3rd minute.

crackup.name: Crack-Up
crackup.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as named: laughing. A grin (1-20) opens into a laugh (25-45, some blur), then a squinting laugh held. The head bobs a lot.

crypto: Their whitepaper is three pages, and one is the cover.
He tried to front-run himself.
football: He missed an open goal from one yard.
The mascot has more goals than their striker this season.

crackup.motion: soft: bounce; keep away from text (the head bobs)

buildup.detail: short: smile -> laugh; start ~15 so the laugh opens on the punchline

crackup.notes: There is no clean 'win' grin in the shirtless set; this is laughter, not pride.
crackup.second_opinion: Avoid 110-130 (head cut square at the right temple). Frames 0-20 = a proud, closed grin (good news / told you so).

nervous.name: Nervous
nervous.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as a forced, cheesy grin at 120-180 px; the wide eyes that make it 'eek' only win at about 400 px and up. Held, no change.
fits: a risk that hasn't happened yet

crypto: It's 50x leverage, and funding just flipped negative.
The unlock is tomorrow: 25% of the supply.
football: 1-0 up, ten minutes left, down to ten men.
The bet needs a clean sheet, and they've conceded in every game.

never: an actual loss (too soft, and reads as a grin)
the peak of an escalating problem (it de-escalates)
nervous.motion: soft: lean in; the thing pulses
nervous.notes: Pair with an obviously risky stimulus (a red bar, a countdown).
nervous.second_opinion: Frames 1-60 read as 'eek' (brows up, clenched teeth) even at 120-200 px; from frame 75 the eyes narrow into a cheesy grin. Use 1-60 ping-pong.

nah.name: Nah
nah.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as him TALKING and waving: the lips move through the whole clip, not just before frame 30. The finger-wag only reads as 'no' where the finger is up and sharp (frames 108-141, 5.5-6.6 s); the first burst (9-42) is a blur.
nah.valence: rejection (good when it rejects the bad thing)
fits: what the app does NOT get

crypto: You never need to send them your seed phrase.
Not the 47 trades, the $8,200 or your login.
football: Don't back the favourite at 1.10.
No. That was never a penalty.

never: under a number while it is read (the moving lips compete)
nah.motion: soft: lean in; the target shakes 'no' with the wag

buildup.detail: talking -> wag burst 1 (9-42, blurred) -> talking (43-79) -> wag burst 2 (80-141), finger clearly up 108-141

nah.avoid_frames: 40-41 and 101-102 (detached fingertip islands with an outline, floating beside the head)
nah.notes: Fix or skip the speck frames before any reuse.
nah.second_opinion: Detached slivers at 13, 40-41, 87, 101-102, 113-115: the clean wag is 116-141. A still raised finger reads 'listen / one sec': 'no' only in motion. Lips move throughout: only in voice gaps.

hmm.name: Hmm
hmm.reads_at_sticker_size: Reads as a smug, knowing smile with the hand on the chin: 'I see what you did there' / 'clever', NOT puzzled. At 120 px it reads as pleased.
fits: the clever part of the mechanism
an intriguing question the next line answers

crypto: Here's the clever part: the data never leaves the site.
So how does it prove it without showing the page?
football: Interesting: they press higher away from home.
He moved the left-back into midfield, and it worked.

never: doubt at a bold claim (reads as approval)

buildup.detail: held, short (2.8 s); ping-pong for longer

hmm.notes: The closest shirtless face to a confident sign-off apart from Wince 1-30.
